subject: EVS
learningObjectives: How breathing helps cool or warm things
examples: Blowing on cold hands in winter
misconceptions: We only breathe out hot air

practiceExercises.question: Why does a mirror become foggy when we breathe on it?
practiceExercises.explanation: The moist air from our breath touches the cool mirror and turns into tiny water drops.

flashcards.back: Instrument used to listen to heartbeat
Increases when we run or exercise

revisionNotes: Breath can be used to blow a whistle, cool food, or warm hands.
commonMistakes: Thinking heartbeat stays the same always
